UPDATE llm_runs
               SET prompt_tokens = $2, completion_tokens = $3, total_tokens = $4,
                   reasoning_tokens = $5, model_used = $6, tool_calls = $7, tool_rounds = $8,
                   duration_ms = $9, outcome = $10, error = $11, metadata = $12, trace = $13,
                   langfuse_trace_id = $14
               WHERE run_id = $1
